description: Manufacturer-scoped model-code decoders for chassis prefixes, VINs and explicit manufacturer model-code fields. A profile is actionable only for its exact make/model, identifier kind, input pattern and known code vocabulary. Unknown formats remain neutral.

nissan_xtrail_2018_specs.title: Nissan X-Trail specifications, October 2018
nissan_xtrail_2018_specs.scope: The vehicle-model-code row identifies HT32 as hybrid 2WD and HNT32 as hybrid 4WD.

nissan_recall_4682.title: X-Trail recall report 4682
nissan_recall_4682.scope: Pairs model DAA-HNT32 with chassis number HNT32-160025, establishing the model-code prefix before the hyphen.

nzta_mvma_model_code.title: Motor Vehicle Register open-data field descriptions
nzta_mvma_model_code.scope: Defines MVMA_MODEL_CODE as a manufacturer-assigned model code recorded at VIN allocation; it does not define the composite value's internal format.

mercedes_205_official_manuals.title: Official C-Class 205 Saloon, Estate, Coupe and Cabriolet owner manuals
mercedes_205_official_manuals.scope: Official manuals enumerate C 200 vehicle types 205.080, 205.280, 205.380 and 205.480; exact companion URLs and pages are recorded in the local evidence note.

mercedes_fin_grundbaumuster.title: Baumuster finden
mercedes_fin_grundbaumuster.scope: Mercedes identifies the six characters after a listed Mercedes WMI, including WDD, as the Grundbaumuster used for parts assignment and describing series, body form and engine. Re-fetched 2026-09-18: the page still enumerates WDB, WDC, WDD, WDF and VSA only, and does not name the newer W1K WMI, so the decoder remains scoped to WDD.

kba_wmi_directory.title: Verzeichnis der Hersteller von Kraftfahrzeugen und Kraftfahrzeuganhaengern - alphabetisch - (SV 3.1), Stand 15. Januar 2026
kba_wmi_directory.scope: The German authority that allocates WMIs records W1K against Mercedes-Benz AG, Stuttgart and WDD against the same Stuttgart passenger-car maker under its former names. It establishes which manufacturer a WMI belongs to and nothing about what any VIN position contains, so it supports no decoder rule; it is recorded because it is the evidence behind keeping the WDD scope.

profiles.note: Scoped to the HNT32-1 value present in the supplied CHASSIS7 field. Add a sourced profile rather than broadening this regex for another format.

Scoped to WDD VIN11 values. Mercedes documents the six characters following WDD as the Grundbaumuster; the manuals enumerate the four supported C 200 type codes. Other WMIs and unknown types remain neutral.

The leading MVMA value corresponds to an official Mercedes type number, but NZTA does not define the composite field format. It may propose a likely reference candidate only; it never vetoes or assigns. VIN11 decoding is handled separately by WMI-scoped profiles.
